name: Catvision Limited
about: Catvision Limited manufactures and distributes video and data products and services in India. It operates through Network Systems, Hospitality Sales, Channel Marketing, and Online Sales divisions. The company offers cable tv and IPTV products, including headends, HFC distribution, and set top boxes; and broadband products, such as OLT, ONU/ONT, and optical accessories. It also provides guest tv and channel distribution services. In addition, the company offers fibre-to-the-home solutions comprising EPON and GPON, and IPTV with over-the-top platforms; hospitality/healthcare solutions, including mini headends and guest room management systems; and video distributions solutions for broadcasters. Further, it installs and maintains industrial, commercial, and domestic CCTV cameras and recording surveillance systems. The company was formerly known as Catvision Products Limited and changed its name to Catvision Limited in March 2011. Catvision Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Noida, India.
